headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, Oct 28: Infosys, RIL shares fall 3%; Apollo Hospitals, L&T gain 4%
headlines.summary: On October 28, the SENSEX declined by 352.64 points or 0.48% to close at 73,246.03. Similarly, the NIFTY50 ended lower by 50.90 points or 0.22% at 22,698.85.

headlines.headline: Market wrap today: SENSEX ends 350 pts lower, NIFTY50 closes at 22,698; IT stocks, Reliance among top losers
headlines.summary: The NIFTY50 and SENSEX ended lower on October 28, as investors focused on the weak global market cues and elevated oil prices ahead of the US Federal Reserve's policy meeting outcome.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms extends rally, tops ₹1,400, trades 27% above issue price; key data points to know
headlines.summary: The Reliance Industries (RIL)-backed digital services company began trading at ₹1,358 apiece on both the BSE and NSE, up 21.36% from its IPO issue price of ₹1,119. Later in the session, the stock extended its gains, advancing as much as 25.52% to ₹1,404.60 on the NSE.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms, L&T among buzzing stocks: SENSEX recovers over 700 pts from day’s low, NIFTY below 22,750
headlines.summary: Piramal Pharma shares rallied as much as 17.9% to hit a 52-week high of ₹234.30 apiece on the NSE on Wednesday, October 28, after the firm swung to profit following broad-based growth across India and overseas sites.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms reshuffles India’s market-cap rankings: Check the revised top 5 list
headlines.summary: Jio Platforms’ ₹30,213 crore initial public offering (IPO) closed with bids for 22.19 times the shares on offer, as total demand across the public issue and anchor investor placement crossed ₹7.4 lakh crore and applications approached a world-beating 1.39 crore.

headlines.headline: Hindustan Unilever Q2 results: Profit rises 4% to ₹2,790 crore, ₹19/share dividend declared; margins under pressure
headlines.summary: Hindustan Unilever posted a nearly 4% growth in its Q2 net profits with key support from the revenue growth in the period, while the FMCG company's margins remained under pressure.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms makes stellar market debut: What Nomura sees driving growth over FY26–FY29
headlines.summary: With its market debut, Jio Platforms has emerged as a major force in India's listed telecom and digital services space, while parent Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) remains a key player in the group's overall market value.

headlines.headline: L&T Q2 FY27 results: Net profit surges 33% YoY to ₹5,202 crore; order intake increases 28%
headlines.summary: Revenue from operations grows 16% driven by accelerated progress in the various businesses in the Projects, Products & Manufacturing (PPM) portfolio, L&T said.

headlines.headline: L&T shares surge over 6% on strong Q2 numbers; order inflows rise 28%
headlines.summary: The company on Tuesday reported a 32.5% rise in consolidated net profit to ₹5,202.10 crore for the quarter ended September 2026, driven by higher revenue.

headlines.headline: SENSEX drops over 700 points, NIFTY50 below 22,600 dragged down by IT shares
headlines.summary: Infosys, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Tata Consultancy Services, Reliance Industries, Bharti Airtel, ITC and HCL Technologies were top drags on the SENSEX.

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Oct 28: Vedanta, Jio Platforms, RIL, L&T, Piramal Pharma, Maruti, Max Financial Services
headlines.summary: Jio Platforms is set to make its much-awaited stock market debut on the BSE and NSE at 10 AM on Wednesday, October 28, marking a landmark moment for India's primary market after its mega IPO.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms set for historic debut at 10 AM: What Akash Ambani told investors
headlines.summary: The Jio Platforms' issue became the first among India’s mega IPOs to achieve full subscription within just 100 minutes of opening and the first global offering to cross the one-crore application mark.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms Q2: Digital services major to announce results on October 30 after Wednesday’s market debut
headlines.summary: Parent company Reliance Industries (RIL), in a stock exchange filing, said that Jio Platforms will announce its September quarter (Q2 FY27) results on Friday, October 30.

headlines.headline: Reliance Industries sets October 30 for Q2 FY27 results; NCD fundraise on board agenda
